items.title: Uniqueness in the valuative criterion implies that the diagonal is separated
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that uniqueness in the valuative criterion for a morphism of algebraic stacks implies that its diagonal is separated (author lemma at source lines 9625-9630, label lemma-converse-uniqueness-and-diagonal). The proof (source lines 9632-9681) interprets a morphism of dotted arrows for the diagonal as two dotted arrows for the original morphism, applies the uniqueness hypothesis to force them to agree, and concludes by the valuative criterion for separatedness (proof lines 9632-9680). The translation between dotted arrows for the diagonal and pairs of dotted arrows for the morphism is the substance. H3.
